_comment: Mode 3 (residue fit): what does an X40 reduce to on one of its
boundaries?  target = the four-parton antenna itself (kin-set
index as last argument); basis = candidate lower-antenna
products, each optionally evaluated on its own mapped momenta
(map + redme fields) — the shape needed for S,b2 iterated
Every UPPERCASE token is a placeholder: IA,IB,... = momentum
indices, ISOFT = the soft leg, X40NAME/X30NAME = antenna entry
points, REDME = reduced ME on the j1..jN mapped indices.
Do NOT copy argument orders blindly - run antenna_slots.py
(slot plumbing) and the pole scan (convention) first; fit both
candidate orders if in doubt: the wrong one is not rational.
The 'limit' field uses the shared mode vocabulary (irlimits.py):
primary here is 'one X40 leg soft'.  For the boundary where one
leg is soft WHILE a pair stays collinear, swap in _alt_limit_sc.
Degeneracy caveat: start from 2-3 basis entries and grow;
symmetry-related orientations are degenerate in a soft limit.
